Brief

Engineering growth, by design.

For over a decade, I’ve sat at the intersection of complex code and conversion-driven strategy. As a Creative Technologist, Program Manager, and Startup Co-Founder at visibility.so, I don’t just build websites – I engineer scalable digital ecosystems that facilitate growth for high-traffic enterprises.

My core capabilities center around three pillars: driving engineering excellence through WordPress & Shopify Development, leading cross-functional developer sprints via Technical Program Management, and shaping digital products using Design Thinking and user-centric systems.

Whether architecting WooCommerce integrations, managing developer workflows, or building search visibility products, I believe technology should feel like an invisible, natural extension of the user’s intent.

Questions

Frequently asked.

What does Sanjay Shankar do?

Sanjay is a technical program manager and engineering leader who co-founded Visibility.so, an agentic SEO platform, and leads product engineering teams at Acodez and Acowebs.

What is agentic SEO?

Agentic SEO uses AI agents to run search optimisation as a continuous loop: monitoring visibility across Google and AI engines, finding opportunities, executing fixes and measuring the result.

How can I work with Sanjay?

Use the contact page, email me@sanjayshankar.me, or message on WhatsApp. Sanjay works with a full-stack team on product engineering, WordPress, Shopify, UI/UX, SEO and no-code builds.
